name: Dearborn River
blurb: Seasonal canyon trip from Highway 287 to the Missouri, ending at Mid Canon FAS. Plan a full day and arrange a shuttle.

sections.notes: About 19 miles according to the 2024 River Management Society trip plan, including about one mile on the Missouri. Arrange the shuttle before launching. The bridge approach can be muddy and deeply potholed; check current access and flows.

notices.title: Corrected start and finish
notices.text: This is the Highway 287 bridge–Mid Canon trip described by the River Management Society, approximately 19 miles. It does not start at Highway 200, and the take-out is downstream of the Dearborn–Missouri confluence. The 2024 full-day itinerary is planning context, not a measured travel-time prediction.
notices.sourceName: River Management Society — 2024 Dearborn day-trip plan

putInAccess.sourceName: River Management Society — 2024 Dearborn day-trip logistics
putInAccess.note: RMS identifies the launch and publishes these coordinates. Treat them as the bridge access area, not a surveyed water-edge ramp. This is Highway 287, not Highway 200 or Bean Lake.
putInAccess.directions: Use the documented Highway 287 bridge pull-off. This is an undeveloped launch: inspect the muddy approach and large potholes before taking a trailer down.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP — Mid Canon FAS; RMS Dearborn trip plan
takeOutAccess.note: FWP’s managed-site inventory documents a gravel ramp and its facility point. The official site map identifies the recreation area; an exact landing-edge coordinate is not claimed.
takeOutAccess.directions: Take out at the signed Mid Canon FAS on the Missouri River, reached from Old US Highway 91. The trip continues about one mile on the Missouri after the Dearborn confluence; the confluence itself is not the take-out.

timing.note: The corrected Highway 287–Mid Canon trip crosses onto the Missouri. A reviewed flow/speed calibration for that trip has not been established.

mapAuditNote: Reviewed 2026-10-28 against the RMS 2024 trip plan and FWP Mid Canon map/inventory. Corrected the launch to Highway 287 and the exit to Mid Canon on the Missouri. Approximate facility map available; old speed model disabled. Legacy section ID retained for existing links.
